Gifted: Emotion Induction.name: Gifted: Emotion Induction
Gifted: Emotion Induction.description:
🧬 Emotion Induction, as an extra Quirk put into your body.

🌱 At the start you make a single person double over laughing or flinch back in fear, and you sense the feelings of everyone nearby, even through a wall.
📈 With training: panicked crowds calmed to orderly exits, dread in a gang, crowds parted silently, villains baited onto you, a laughing street, a crippling feeling lifted.
⚠️ It works on feelings, never thoughts, and people fear what it could do to them.
🔗 Common drawback pairing: Loss of Control, as the feeling you push spills onto everyone near you.
🎬 Similar canon Quirks: Ms. Joke (Outburst).

⚠️ Less practiced than your main Quirk: no technique cards of its own; the story plays it from its rules.
Gifted: Emotion Induction.traitNarrativeEffects: Gifted extra Quirk (Emotion Induction family): Scale: the user pushes raw feelings onto people nearby: at first laughter, calm or fear onto one or a few within about ten meters, and senses strong feelings through walls. A push lasts seconds to a minute and colors behavior, but never gives orders or plants thoughts. Other feelings and more need learned techniques. Limits: a strong will, training or a stronger ruling feeling blunts a push. It cannot read thoughts, change memories, create love or trust, or make anyone betray what they hold dearest. Quirk Strain: light: push, reading the room; moderate: calming or parting a crowd, wall of dread; heavy: goading rage, setting an area laughing; severe: signature flood, lifting a feeling out of someone. Type: Emitter. Law: pushing feelings without consent counts as mind control and voids deals or confessions under it; licensed users announce themselves and only calm, rally or subdue.
